items.title: Tencent Hunyuan Releases Hy3D 3.6 for Professional High-Poly 3D Assets
items.excerpt: Tencent Hunyuan shipped Hy3D 3.6, a VAE + DiT 3D generation model aimed at production high-poly geometry and PBR texture maps for retopology, baking, 3D printing and film pipelines. It is API/product access (Tencent Cloud, Miora agent, LAP, WorkRally), not an open-weights drop. Off-list domain (no on-list render outlet covered it). Note: og:image is an AI conceptual illustration, not a Hy3D output.

items.title: Cascadeur 2026.3 Adds MetaHuman Faces and Tentacle Rigging
items.excerpt: Nekki's AI- and physics-assisted animation tool Cascadeur 2026.3 adds MetaHuman face support and tentacle rigging, cleans up mocap jitter automatically, and lets outside AI assistants such as Claude Code edit scenes. Date and summary from AWN RSS (page is bot-walled). Off-list domain.

items.title: Unreal Engine 6 Will Ship Without Blueprints
items.excerpt: Epic says UE6 will drop Blueprints visual scripting and rely on AI to port existing UE5 projects to Verse, citing a Fortnite prototype built by converting more than 20,000 visual scripts; new AI tools land in UE 5.9 first. Date from AWN RSS. Cross-section risk: games has covered UE6 AI repeatedly.

items.title: Unsloth Inkling 2 Mini: drive Unreal, Unity and Blender with local MCP
items.excerpt: Guide to running the open Inkling 2 Mini model locally in Unsloth Desktop and connecting it over MCP to Blender, Unreal and Unity for asset and scene work, and how that differs from cloud agents. Weak: tutorial/guide from an off-list blog.

items.title: THEIA update automates 3D models
items.excerpt: Spare Parts 3D updated THEIA AI to automate reconstruction of 3D models from 2D engineering drawings in formats compatible with engineering CAD software. (THEIA was carded once in Aug via engineering.com; this is a new update.)

items.title: "AI로 나만의 공간 디자인"...직스테크놀로지, '2회 ZYXCAD AX 경진대회' 성료
items.excerpt: ZYX Technology and MBN held awards for the 2nd ZYXCAD AX contest themed '2035 future': 59 teams / 104 people competed in design (CAD) and video tracks using AI-assisted space design. Event/awards story; weaker than a product release.

items.title: Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models
items.excerpt: Three new papers from Meta and LeCun's AMI Labs advance JEPA, an architecture meant to give machines an internal world model of cause and effect, as an alternative to LLMs. World-model research; design hook is indirect (spatial/3D generation future).

items.title: 벤타엑스·스톤브이스튜디오, 영화 '한산'에 AI 접목한 VR 콘텐츠 내년 출시
items.excerpt: VentaX and StoneV Studio rebuilt production data from the film 'Hansan' with AI into a VR experience launching next year; 95% of beta visitors said they would pay. AI-reconstructed immersive content pipeline.

items.title: Android's DIY widgets are a bit of vibe-coding fun
items.excerpt: Hands-on with Gemini-powered Create My Widget on Android: users describe a widget in plain language and get a generated, working home-screen UI. Prompt-to-UI for consumers. Cross-section risk: gadgets carded Create My Widget on 09-26 and 11-06.

items.title: FigmaのAI画像生成を拡充、1回の指示で最大6枚生成可能
items.excerpt: Figma updated its AI image generation: up to six images per prompt, and the same prompt can be sent to up to three models side by side for comparison. Off-list Japanese design outlet; event dated 11-24 on the page.

items.title: How Cozey turns its operators into software builders on Vercel
items.excerpt: Furniture retailer Cozey runs its storefront on Vercel and lets warehouse, finance and support staff build internal apps with AI coding agents. Vendor customer story; vibe-coding-by-non-engineers case.

items.title: How to set up the Figma MCP server with Claude Code (and get code that matches your design)
items.excerpt: Step-by-step setup of Figma's MCP server with Claude Code so generated code follows the actual design file. Tutorial, not news.

items.title: DESIGN.md: The missing layer between your design system and AI
items.excerpt: Nick Babich explains how a DESIGN.md file gives AI agents the context a design system lacks, with six tips for writing one. Note: DESIGN.md has been carded 4+ times (Jul-Sep), so this needs a new angle.

items.title: Your coding agent keeps writing the same UI. Give it real components instead
items.excerpt: Argues coding agents produce generic sections (the same pricing block everyone gets) unless fed a real component library, and shows how to wire components in as agent context.

items.title: Pin agent border-radius to the existing radius tokens — no magic rounded values
items.excerpt: How to stop coding agents from shipping ad-hoc values like rounded-[10px] by pinning them to existing radius tokens. Note: same author's 'spacing scale' piece was carded 11-24, so this is a near-duplicate angle.

items.title: How I use AI as a solo designer
items.excerpt: A designer who moved from a 30+ person design team to being the only designer at a B2B e-commerce scale-up describes which AI workflows worked (and which failed), going beyond Figma Make, Gemini and Maze-assisted interviews. Date/excerpt from RSS (page is Cloudflare-gated).

items.title: Who draws the in-betweens?
items.excerpt: Essay using Dior's AI-assisted holiday short by Sylvain Chomet and the internet's finger-counting backlash to argue that authorship lives in creative decisions, not in which tool drew the frames. Barely inside the window.

items.title: Designing for the AI agent customer
items.excerpt: Personal AI assistants already compare and buy on users' behalf, and persuasion tactics built for humans don't work on agents. Covers what changes in UX and marketing design. Barely inside the window; marketing overlap.

items.title: 電通が「Geminiを使いこなすFDE」ら3000人育成プログラムを開始
items.excerpt: Dentsu launched a program to train 3,000 staff, including forward-deployed engineers fluent in Gemini Enterprise, to push AI use across its business. Creative-agency AX at scale. Off-list domain; marketing overlap. RSS 09:45 JST used (JSON-LD wrongly says 09:45Z).

items.title: “사람만 보고 디자인해선 안 된다”... AI 에이전트 시대 UX 기고문 눈길
items.excerpt: Korean design outlet on a column arguing that UX must now design information for AI agents as well as human users, as agent use spreads. Opinion roundup. Off-list domain.

items.title: 대신 전화 걸어주는 비서? AI 에이전트 UX의 한계와 전망
items.excerpt: Analysis of AI phone-call agents as a UX case: where agent UX breaks down, and how UX design's subject is widening from screens to agent behavior. Off-list domain.

items.title: 5 Game-Changing Ways to Use AI in 2026
items.excerpt: Year-end video on the five AI workflow changes that mattered most, including the 'context sandwich' prompt structure and how the channel makes its animations with Claude. Weak design hook.

items.title: DeepMind's New AI Just Changed The AI Race
items.excerpt: Two Minute Papers walks through Gemini 4 Neon and its safety report, using community demos. General model news; weak design hook.
